name: Bubble Sort
code:
# Bubble Sort (RISC-V assembly)
# Sorts the array in place: a[0] .. a[n-1]
#
# a0 = base address of the array
# a1 = number of elements n
# t0 = i (outer loop), t1 = j (inner loop)

    li a0, 0x0          # base address of the array
    li a1, 0xA          # n = 10 elements
    addi t0, a1, -1     # i = n - 1

outer:                        # for i = n-1 down to 1
    blt t0, zero, done        # i < 1 -> finished
    li t1, 0x0                # j = 0

inner:                        # for j = 0 .. i-1
    bge t1, t0, endinner      # j >= i -> pass finished
    slli t2, t1, 0x2          # t2 = j * 4
    add t2, a0, t2            # t2 = &a[j]
    lw  t3, 0x0(t2)           # t3 = a[j]
    lw  t4, 0x4(t2)           # t4 = a[j+1]
    bge t4, t3, noswap        # a[j+1] >= a[j] -> already in order, skip the swap
    sw  t4, 0x0(t2)           # a[j]   = a[j+1]
    sw  t3, 0x4(t2)           # a[j+1] = a[j]
noswap:
    addi t1, t1, 0x1          # j++
    j inner

endinner:
    addi t0, t0, -1           # i--
    j outer

done:                         # the array in memory is now sorted
